data.one_liner: A customizable calendar widget with day, multi-day, month, and schedule views.
data.what_it_does: Provides a calendar widget supporting day, multi-day, month, and schedule views. Includes features such as drag-and-drop rescheduling, event resizing, timezones, and customizable appearance and behavior.
use_when: You need a calendar component with day, multi-day, month, and schedule views.
Your application requires drag-and-drop event rescheduling and resizing.
avoid_when: You only need a simple date picker widget instead of a full calendar/scheduler.
strengths: Multiple built-in views (Day, Multi-day, Month, Schedule).
Supports drag-and-drop rescheduling and event resizing.
weaknesses: Still in development with breaking changes landing in minor releases until 1.0.0.
data.setup_notes: Add the package via pub add. Optional timezone and intl packages can be added for location and locale support.
